name: Gracious Handgrip
description: Grip a board in each hand with the shafts parallel, so the pair works as one tool.

name: Parity Cupend
description: Draw both boards back together to the same height, matching the load on each arm.

name: Spurcrown
description: Release both darts at once on flat parallel lines a shoulder's width apart.

name: Valiant Whipover
description: Cast left, right, left in an even rhythm, so the foe finds no gap between casts.

name: Unwavering Spurhook
description: Cross the boards before the face to knock a thrown dart aside, then uncross for the reply.

name: Extendsolace
description: Step forward on alternating feet in time with the alternating casts, closing without breaking rhythm.

name: Radiance Propel
description: Throw one dart high and one low so their paths scissor through the foe's guard.

name: Triumphant Throwlever
description: Keep both boards casting in parallel streams, so a foe must watch two lines of flight at once.

name: Illustrious Overarm
description: Loose both darts into the same point at the same instant, and the pair drives through plate.

name: Matchless Throwlever
description: The school's founding cast: two darts, one from each board, falling together on the mark with the thrower's measure of qi.

name: Vigorcup
description: Draw a sharp breath through the nose and let a short cry out with the cast, timing arm and voice.

name: Sainted Atlshaft
description: Settle on the basin rim with weight low, steady as a hawk on a post.

name: Peal Dartshaft
description: Mark the foe's eye line and the set of his shoulders to learn which way he will move.

name: Cupverdict
description: Cast on the cry's last note, so the dart arrives while the foe's ear is still full.

name: Despotic Whipover
description: Loose a cry as the dart passes the foe's ear, breaking his focus and spoiling his next move.

name: Thunderclap Extend
description: Strike the far basin side with a dart so the returning sound draws the foe's guard that way.

name: Windborne Weightstone
description: Circle the foe at a hawk's wide radius, casting whenever his back turns.

name: Merciful Flexshaft
description: Reload on the beat of a cry, so the foe hears the shout and misses the dart seating.

name: Gallant Leverage
description: Cry and cast so a second dart follows the first while the foe's guard still rises for the cry.

name: Millstone Overarm
description: Cast with a rising shriek, forcing foes to cower or retreat from the fall of darts.

name: Propeldecree
description: Plunge in a single motion from cry to cast, so the dart strikes with the whole weight of the dive.

name: Extendbanner
description: The school's great cast: one cry and one dart, loosed with the full reserve the thrower can spare.

name: Spectral Throwstick
description: Wade through reeds on the balls of the feet, parting stems with the board's tail.

name: Luminous Handgrip
description: Time each step to the wind's rustle, so the reeds cover the sound of a footfall.

name: Squall Throwlever
description: Cast through a narrow gap between reed stems without touching a single stalk.

name: Royal Propel
description: Cast a dart that rides a wedge of qi, pushing stems aside along its path.

name: Prismpropel
description: Skip a dart across still water so it rises beyond the reeds and strikes a foe on the far side.

name: Fleet Flexshaft
description: Fall back into thick reeds after a cast, leaving the foe to search where nothing stands.

name: Tranquil Dartshaft
description: Read the swaying of reed tips to track a foe moving unseen below them.

name: Steel Whipover
description: Rise from within the reeds and cast at close range while the foe is still looking elsewhere.

name: Subjugating Cupend
description: Drive a dart through a foe's trailing garment into soft mud, so the bog holds him fast.

name: Propeledict
description: Stand still in the reeds like a heron until the instant of opportunity, then cast with the full force of the body.

name: Heroic Whipover
description: The school's quiet cast: a dart that leaves the reeds without sound, carrying the thrower's measure of qi.

name: Hospitable Gripbinding
description: Balance the weight of board and dart across both hands, so neither arm outworks the other.

name: Prismcup
description: Stand with the face turned slightly skyward, watching for falling darts as well as casting.

name: Famed Overarm
description: Release each dart at the same pace and angle as its pair so both land together.

name: Noble Extend
description: Pass the dart from hand to hand mid-throw, so the board arm changes without breaking the cast.

name: Throwstick Banner
description: Lob two darts high over a raised shield line to drop on the foes behind it.

name: Faithful Throwstick
description: Raise both boards overhead to turn aside a shower of missiles.

name: Thrall Whipover
description: Pin a foe's two sleeves in one cast of paired darts, leaving his hands bound to his own sides.

name: Spurtriumph
description: Send pairs of darts in rolling descent, each pair striking where the last pair opened the guard.

name: Dauntless Weightstone
description: Throw both darts into one spot with both arms in full measure, and only a heavy shield turns them.

name: Cupendverdict
description: The school's measured cast: paired darts on matched arcs, loosed with all the reserve the Canon's student can spare.

name: Sphere Gripbinding
description: Trace the full curve of a dart's flight in the mind before it is thrown.

name: Bountiful Spurhook
description: Seat the dart on the spur inside the qi field, so it rests within the thrower's own sphere.

name: Revered Cupend
description: Spread weight evenly across both feet, so the arc is never skewed by a lean.

name: Propelbanner
description: Release at the arc's true angle with qi guiding the dart's tail.

name: Intrepid Throwlever
description: Throw a dart that climbs steeply and falls onto a target hidden behind a rise.

name: Fearless Whipover
description: Cast a dart that flies almost level for a long way, then dips onto the mark.

name: Clement Fingerhooks
description: Alter the arc mid-flight with a pulse of qi when the foe steps aside.

name: Squall Overarm
description: Step beneath the dart's curve to stay in line with the foe's next move.

name: Lordly Extend
description: Shape a dart's path as a long curve around cover, steered by the qi thread.

name: Symphonic Leverage
description: Cast darts on three separate arcs, flat, middle and high, so they all fall in the same instant.

name: Pulsarspur
description: Gather the qi field into the dart and send it down a flawless arc to pierce a hardened guard.

name: Majestic Overarm
description: The school's highest cast: a dart on a perfect arc, with every measure of qi the thrower can bring to it.

name: Kernel Handgrip
description: Let the core's warmth rise into the palm until the board feels part of the hand.

name: Wise Dartshaft
description: Watch the near and far horizons at once, keeping both in the mind's eye.

name: Storied Propel
description: Cast with the core's quiet power behind the arm, so the dart leaves smooth and sure.

name: Cupdecree
description: Send a pulse from the core down the arm at the instant of release for a harder throw.

name: Paramount Whipover
description: Cast one dart to a near mark and one to a far mark in a single breath.

name: Cupendvoyage
description: Walk the line where earth meets sky, keeping both near and far in sight.

name: Nucleus Weightstone
description: Sweep qi-sense from the core in a wide ring to find foes hidden near or far.

name: Exalted Throwlever
description: Loose a dart toward each horizon at once, to strike two foes at far ends of the field.

name: Quenched Overarm
description: Drive the core's power through the shaft so the dart punches through rock-hard guard.

name: Spuredict
description: Cast from a height with the core's full force, and the dart falls on its prey with a hawk's certainty.

name: Solarextend
description: The school's core cast: darts sent to both horizons together, drawn from the thrower's formed core.

name: Nurturing Spurhook
description: Speak the first oath of the plateau thrower aloud, binding the cast to a word given to the wind.

name: Consecrated Dartshaft
description: Root the feet wide on the plateau's bare earth to meet the wind's push.

name: Sovereign Atlshaft
description: Take a bearing and cast along it, the dart holding true to the sworn line.

name: Extendverdict
description: Lean the body into the wind and cast, so the dart bores through it.

name: Vigor Throwstick
description: Reload to the rhythm of the oath, so each cast follows the last in measured time.

name: Skyborne Handgrip
description: Slide a pace along the wind and cast from the new bearing.

name: Cupmercy
description: Glance at a distant landmark to check that the bearing has not drifted.

name: Commanding Flexshaft
description: Cast a dart through a foe's cloak into the earth, holding him to the spot as an oath holds a sworn man.

name: Deluge Propel
description: Cast a volley down a gale across open ground, so the wind scatters the foe's cover.

name: Splendid Gripbinding
description: Speak the full oath and loose a dart that breaks through any guard raised against it.

name: Sovereign Leverage
description: The school's first cast: a dart sworn to a bearing and loosed with whatever reserve the oath-taker can give.

name: Bedrock Spurhook
description: Choose firm open ground with no ditch, root or stone to catch the heel.

name: Serene Handgrip
description: Keep the eyes on the horizon and sense the wind's shifts before they reach the body.

name: Cupedict
description: Cast level and fast along open ground when no cover is near.

name: Majestic Leverage
description: Meet a charging foe with a cast timed to land as his lead foot falls.

name: Spurgrace
description: Back away across open ground at a steady pace, casting on every tenth step.

name: Interstice Gripbinding
description: Read a dust cloud on the horizon to count and place the foes approaching.

name: Magnificent Throwlever
description: Drive a dart into the center of a charging line, breaking its stride.

name: Orchestral Whipover
description: Answer a volley with a sequence of casts, each aimed where the enemy thrower last stood.

name: Propelcrown
description: Loose a dart sworn to the wind's own course, so it passes through guard like a gale through grass.

name: Extendtriumph
description: The school's open cast: a dart given to the wind, with the full reserve the sworn thrower can give.

name: Undefiled Weightstone
description: Lean the shoulders into the gale and bend the knees, so the wind passes over the body.

name: Bountiful Dartshaft
description: Speak a short word to anchor the bearing in the mind against the buffeting wind.

name: Cupgift
description: Hunch over the board to shelter the dart on its spur while loading in the wind.

name: Vaunted Propel
description: Cast directly into a rising gale, aiming high and trusting the bearing.

name: Peerless Extend
description: Throw against a gale with the whole body behind the arm, so the dart wins its way through.

name: Ethereal Cupend
description: Sprint across open ground in the lull between gusts and drop into a cast.

name: Compassionate Spurhook
description: Find a bearing lost to a violent gust by a glance at a landmark.

name: Pallspur
description: Angle the board so a missile riding the wind slides off its flat.

name: Unrivaled Overarm
description: Cast against the strongest gust with qi pushing the dart's core, driving the point home.

name: Atlshaft Crown
description: Keep the same bearing through a long gale, casting on without a change of aim.

name: Spurdecree
description: Cast a dart that no wind bends, held to its bearing by the whole will of the thrower.

name: Valiant Throwlever
description: The school's steadfast cast: a dart that holds its bearing against a gale, with the thrower's full measure of qi.

name: Vigor Gripbinding
description: Set the feet one long stride apart and load the rear leg so the throw uses the whole body.

name: Wise Fingerhooks
description: Pick a landmark at the far edge of the plateau and hold the eyes on it through the throw.

name: Extendcrown
description: Reach the casting arm as far forward as it will go and release at the full stretch.

name: Dauntless Throwlever
description: Pace out the distance in strides and set the arc to match before casting.

name: Cupboon
description: Recover balance after a heavy cast with one long forward stride.

name: Fearless Propel
description: Cast upslope onto a ridge with the arc raised to meet the rise of the ground.

name: Season Atlshaft
description: Stretch a line of qi to the far mark and hold it until the dart finds it.

name: Triumphant Extend
description: Cast at the very limit of a heavy dart's reach with qi down the full shaft.

name: Steelpropel
description: Send successive casts to the same far mark, each correcting the last, until one strikes.

name: Pulsar Leverage
description: Hold a full breath and pour qi into the board until one dart carries to the far limit of range.

name: Spurbanner
description: The school's long cast: one dart to the farthest mark, loosed with the master's whole measure of qi.

name: Serene Gripbinding
description: Read the wind's strength and direction from the bend of grass and the drift of dust.

name: Penumbra Handgrip
description: Link the qi field to the moving air, so the wind feels like a limb of the thrower.

name: Heroic Overarm
description: Cast so the dart leaves the board already carried by the wind's current.

name: Propelverdict
description: Let a rising wind lift the dart past a raised shield line or a ridge.

name: Swift Weightstone
description: Step with the wind's push, covering twice the ground in one stride.

name: Luminous Throwstick
description: Thread qi through the air along the dart's path and feel the wind's shifts for it.

name: Noble Whipover
description: Turn the dart mid-flight on a gust, so it curls onto a foe's unguarded flank.

name: Cuptriumph
description: Send darts down one stream of wind, each riding its pull to the same far point.

name: Steel Throwlever
description: Gather wind and qi into one dart and send it through guard on a gale of its own.

name: Magnificent Propel
description: The school's carried cast: a dart borne by wind and qi together, with all the reserve the thrower can bring.

name: Compassionate Cupend
description: Breathe with the core, drawing the plateau wind in and letting it out with the cast.

name: Kernel Dartshaft
description: Feel the plateau's bearing through the core as a settled line the throw must follow.

name: Spurpledge
description: Root the stance deep with qi from the core, so the plateau gale cannot move the feet.

name: Famed Whipover
description: Cast from the rooted stance with the arm alone, and let the core hold the body still.

name: Cupendedict
description: Send a pulse of core and gale together down the board at the moment of release.

name: Soundless Atlshaft
description: Sweep across the plateau on core-lightened legs, never settling in one place for long.

name: Heroic Throwstick
description: Spread casts across the bearings of a gale, so the dart falls wherever the wind carries it.

name: Gracious Fingerhooks
description: Read the pressure and temper of the air through the core to know when a gale is coming.

name: Propeltriumph
description: Pour core and gale into a long barrage of darts that rolls across the plateau like a storm.

name: Magma Overarm
description: Gather core and gale, then cast a wide fall of darts that sweeps a broad stretch of the plateau.

name: Pulsarcup
description: Drive core, gale and arm into one dart that no armor can turn.

name: Cupendbanner
description: The school's core cast: a dart given the plateau's gale and the thrower's formed core, with the whole reserve.
